name: Future Stars Multi-Sport Camp at University of Southern Maine
description_short: Multi-sport day camp for ages 6 to 16 at the University of Southern Maine in Portland, run by Future Stars. Weekly sessions, 9 am to 4 pm; campers are grouped by age and skill and rotate through tennis, soccer, lacrosse, flag football, basketball, softball, volleyball, recreational games and swim.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is part of the daily recreational games rotation; the page gives no pool or swim-lesson details.

source.title: Multi-Sport Day Camp at University of Southern Maine | Future Stars

warnings: The 2027 dates and prices aren't published yet ("2027 Dates & Rates Coming Soon"), and the 2026 table shows "no programs available in Portland for Multi-Sport." No sessions or prices were recorded.

The Purchase, NY phone (914) 273-8500 is the company's main office. The Portland site's own number is (207) 378-1000.
